game.title: Classic Literature: Did You Actually Read It?
game.description: Ten questions from the novels, plays, and poems that appear on every English class syllabus. No SparkNotes shortcuts here.

questions.prompt: In George Orwell's 1984, what is the name of the all-seeing figurehead of the totalitarian Party whose face appears on posters throughout Oceania?
In Harper Lee's To Kill a Mockingbird, Atticus Finch is a doctor who volunteers to defend Tom Robinson, a Black man falsely accused of a crime.
In Shakespeare's Romeo and Juliet, which two families are locked in a bitter feud?
In F. Scott Fitzgerald's The Great Gatsby, Gatsby stares longingly across the bay at a light on Daisy's dock. What color is that light?
In Mary Shelley's Frankenstein, the creature assembled and brought to life by Dr. Frankenstein is never given a name anywhere in the novel.
What is the full name of the cynical, teenage narrator and protagonist of J.D. Salinger's The Catcher in the Rye? (First and last name)
In John Steinbeck's Of Mice and Men, what is the shared dream that keeps George and Lennie going?

options: To sail to California and start over
To own their own land, tend rabbits, and live off the fat of the land
To save enough money to bring Lennie's family from the South
To open a small restaurant in a city

questions.prompt: Complete the famous opening line of Jane Austen's Pride and Prejudice: "It is a truth universally acknowledged, that a single man in possession of a good fortune, must be in want of a ___." (one word)
In William Golding's Lord of the Flies, the boys stranded on the island are eventually rescued — a naval officer arrives at the very end of the novel.
In George Orwell's Animal Farm, which pig character represents Joseph Stalin and eventually seizes power over the farm?
Which of the following novels were written by Charles Dickens? Select all that apply.
Which of the following statements about Shakespeare's Hamlet are true? Select all that apply.

options: Hamlet is a Prince of Denmark
Hamlet's father was murdered by his uncle Claudius
The play ends happily with Hamlet becoming king
Ophelia drowns during the events of the play
Hamlet's full name is revealed as William Hamlet in the original text

questions.prompt: Which of these classic books do you actually own a physical copy of? Select all that apply.
